balls.text: fires that full and wide outside off, he fails to dig it out and the non striker charged off
pushes it down to long-on and they manage a couple
finds the fielder at long-on, makes room and it's mistimed and Hodge gets under it at long-on
makes room and he slogs and the ball drops in front of deep midwicket

fielding blooper there from Watson, Watson was at cover and the ball was driven to him but he was very slow to react, he moved to his right while the ball was to his left, realised a bit too late, the captain has goofed up, they can only smile
Richardson round the wicket and fires it on the stumps and he drills it down to long-on
should have put that away, full toss on the pads and clipped off the pads to fine leg
low full toss and he makes room and drives him down to deep cover
this was short and he swiveled to pull but mistimed it to short fine leg
slower ball outside off and he makes room and carves it to deep cover
welcome boundary there, Faulkner errs by bowling it too wide outside off and short, he makes room and slaps it down to deep point
that's a good ball, really full and difficult to get it away, Faulkner picks up
full in length outside off and he drives him down to deep cover
hammered down the ground and he nearly claimed the non striker, long-off does well to cut it off
this was banged in short and he hooks it to fine leg
Richardson removes the dangerous Sammy! This was a length ball and Sammy made room to smash this over the off side, top edge and Samson gets under the skier
he opens the face and steers it to the off side

finds the fielder in the deep on the leg side but for a change it's not Richardson, but Rahane, this was a friendly full toss and Rahul whipped it straight to deep midwicket, the extra ball (die to the wide) producing a wicket
follows it up with a full ball on the stumps and he drills it to cover
Kulkarni comes round the wicket, full toss down the leg side
that gets the crowd going! This was banged in a on a good length, Rahul was back at the crease and pulled it in front of square over deep midwicket
looked like the slower bouncer, Rahul backed away and looked to upper cut but missed it
Sammy looked to pull that with more force but he held back and softly places it to square leg
slower ball and he drives him to cover, the DJ announces the 100 and there's hardly a ripple
drills a low full toss down to long-on, end of an excellent spell by canny Bhatia
looked a bit ungainly but effective, he shuffled across his stumps, exposed all of them and slogged him just wide of short fine leg
this one is fuller and he drives him hard to cover
Sammy stays back and chops it to point, not yet in his hitting length
he stays back and works it wide of mid-on
Rahul gets on his knee and fetches it from the off stump and looks to slog and it is in the air and drops short of long-on
bowls it flat and restricts Sammy from going for the big hit, goes back and cuts hard to point
flatter one and he mistimes it to the leg side
comes down the track and he drives him to long-on
he rocks back and thumps it down to mid-off
drifts down the leg side and he clips it towards short fine leg
feeds it too wide down the leg side, pulls out of the stroke
he makes room and looks to cut but gets an outside edge, short third man cuts it off
goes back and punches it hard to cover
full outside off and Rahul drives to long-off
slower ball and he punches it to the off side

like Dhawan even Warner finds the man in the deep on the on side, this was a slower ball and bowled a bit short, Warner rocks back and pulls in front of square but finds Richardson at deep midwicket, went straight to him,  Richardson has all three catches
bowls that full on the stumps and he digs it out back to the bowler
close shout for an lbw, across the line and may have missed the stumps
he looks to cut but misses
Dropped  by Faulkner, Tambe gives it more air and temps Warner to go for the slog, it was hit flat and dipped towards Faulkner at long-on, dived forward and couldn't catch it, not the easiest take
flatter one and he works it to the leg side
he comes down the track and drills it to mid-off
slower ball and he goes back at the crease and works it down to long-on
on the pads and he works it towards mid-on
Rahul plays his first ball back to the bowler
found the fielder with precision, it was the off cutter from Bhatia, Dhawan was down on his knee to slog, played it flat and found Richardson at deep square leg
another slower one and he mistimes the slog
this was the slower leg cutter, he mistimes it to the bowler
keeps it nice and straight and warner gets on the backfoot and works it wide of midwicket, does well to run two
slower ball outside off and he steers it down to third man
gives him width and he bashes it down the ground to long-off
bowls it full and wide outside off and he bends and opens the face and steers it to third man
width outside the off stump and he angles it down to third man
big swing and a miss by Warner, the frustration getting to him? Outside off and he misses it completely
full on the stumps and he drives straight back to Binny
good placement again by Dhawan, third man was up, he had the width outside off to steer it wide of point
looks to drive straighter and he gets an inside edge to the leg side
full on the off stump and he drives to mid-off
drives square on the front foot and backward point does well to stop it
slower ball outside the off stump, he punches it down to sweeper cover, the fielder strikes the stumps at the bowler's end
down the track and he mistimes the drive wide of cover
picks the googly just in time and pushes it to the off side
gives him width and he chops it to the off side
the big hit took a while coming! Tossed up on middle and leg, Dhawan was on his knee and slogged it high over deep midwicket
chips down the track and he clips it to the on side
this was really short and wide and the batsman really had to reach out, chopped to the off side
another slower one and he mistimes the flick to the leg side
a bit wide outside the off stump, slower ball and he gets an outside edge but Faulkner dives and saves it at short third man
full and wide outside off and driven to sweeper cover
full outside the off stump and driven to long-off
the off cutter, he flicks it to the leg side and sets off quickly
skids on the pads and he looks to work it to the leg side but the ball rolls to the off side
flat and he stays back and clips it wide of the bowler
flatter one and he stays back and knocks it back to the bowler
flatter one and he works it to the leg side
flatter delivery and he gets forward and across and drives him towards long-off
tossed up and he pushes it towards point
he bowls a flatter one, he stays back and punches it wide of mid-on
he stays back and punches it wide of the bowler, sets off and Faulkner charges to his right and tries to cut off the single
he tucks it away behind square leg
that's a lovely cover drive! Half volley outside off, he leans forward and drives crisply wide of cover, races away
on the pads and flicked to the on side
good length outside off and punched to the off side

Dropped! This was coming straight at his face, slower ball and Dhawan was looking to drive straight and it was chipped back at Faulkner, he cupped his hands in front of his face, slipped and couldn't hang on
shuffles across early and he mistimes the flick to the leg side
fetches that from the off stump and clips it to the leg side, good use of wrists
good running, he merely pushed it with soft hands towards cover and sets off quickly, Warner is quick to respond
kept him quiet there by bowling it dead straight, on middle and skidded through, he defends
he strays too wide down the leg side and wide called
he goes back at the crease and clips it to the on side
after hardly any boundaries in the first four overs we have two in a row, full outside off and he lofts him over mid-off
you gotta love this one for the placement! Third man was up and Dhawan knew that, the ball was angled across and he had enough width to deftly steer that wide of short third man and backward point
this was full on the off stump and he pushes it wide of mid-off
just a short arm flick towards midwicket and they complete a single
short of a length on the leg stump and he mistimes the flick to the on side
tucked him up for room there, he went back to defend and the ball nearly rolled over to the stumps
punched towards mid-off and there's a misfield and that allows a single
gives width outside off and he cuts wide of point, it looks like going all the way to the rope but Binny does well to slide and cut it off
fullish on the pads and clipped just wide of mid-on
he bowls it full on the stumps, pushes it just in front of mid-on and sets off
oh dear he lost control of that! This was far too wide down the leg side and the wicketkeeper could do nothing
this time he strays on the pads and he clips it away to the leg side
he gives him a bit of width this time and he chops it just wide of cover
Faulkner fires this one full outside off and he digs it out to cover
angled across him again and he reaches out and chops it to the off side
this was angled wider across the left-hander and he flashed at it, Richardson working up good pace
that's a good yorker and Dhawan really had to dig that out to the leg side, nearly lost his balance
good length outside off and he punched it to the off side
He gets a lovely shape across the left hander and Dhawan was in a fix, fished at it outside off
he strays wide down the leg side
this was still a bit short and he went back and chopped it to extra cover

that's a soft dismissal! But that wasn't a terribly good delivery either, this was short and wide outside off, the invitation was there for the cut but Finch could only hit it straight to Richardson at cover, didn't time it well and an easy catch in the end
this is a good few balls by Kulkarni, bowls it straight and he stands back and defends
he strays on the pads and he flicks it away wide of midwicket
makes him play yet again and he defends this to the off side
on target straightaway, shapes away slightly and Finch solidly defends

back to back fours to finish things off! Bhuvneshwar fails to get the yorker in yet again, this time it's a low full toss and the Australian makes room and places it down to the vacant deep point region
Faulkner doesn't need a sighter! This was too full and wide outside off, Faulkner made room and smashed it wide of cover, the sweeper can't cut it off
starts off with a yorker and it's a single, he makes room and jams it out to deep cover
that was a snorter from Steyn, quick one on the body and Binny swings and the ball hits his body and drops to the off side
Binny makes room and he makes too much of it, can't slap it away
Binny meanwhile relieves the pressure with a boundary, he makes room to a length ball and cuts him hard and fast past backward point, big gap there

another wicket goes and Hyderabad are still in it! Or wait... they are checking the catch at the deep, it was the off cutter from Steyn, Bhatia was aiming to clear long-on, the ball dips as it reaches Finch who was quite in front of the rope, he falls forward and takes it inches off the ground, replays confirm that the catch was clean
looked like the slower one and he made room and failed to get bat on ball
what a way to start the over! Bhatia whips a full delivery on middle and leg with such force that the ball blazes away wide of midwicket
turns it wide of midwicket and they hurry the second run, the fielders are not happy they conceded two
a pressure-relieving boundary for Binny, this was flighted on the pads, he was on his knee early and swept it firmly to fine leg

impatience gets the better off Hodge! Is there a twist? Determined to fetch a boundary he risks slogging against the turn, it was the leg break, fetches it from outside off, Sammy takes it well in front of the deep midwicket rope
the googly! This was bowled slower and it spun  back in and kept low, Hodge nearly dragged it on
comes forward and drives back to the bowler
Binny went down the track and was foxed by Mishra's flight, ended up getting a leading edge
tries to work it to the legside but misses
Hodge goes for the slog but misses
flatter one and he turns it away to long leg
turns it against the turn to midwicket and he's off the mark
gets forward and drives to cover
drills it back to the bowler

Rahane's caught in the deep but has it come too late for Hyderabad? Rahane continues to give the bowlers the charge, this was tossed up, Rahane made room for himself to free his arms as he looked to clear long-off, hit it flat and straight to Finch
tossed up and he goes for the sweep but doesn't control it
this was tossed up wide outside off and he flays at it, beats cover and Finch does well to move to his left, slide and cut it off
goes back and punches a googly to long-on
gives it more air and he drills it down the track
they continue to use their feet, this time he's lucky as the inside edge trickles past the stumps
cleverly played but just a single, this was short and he weaved backwards, opened the face and steered it one bounce to third man
fires a full ball on the pads and he makes room and digs it out to the on side
this was shorter and Binny made room, weaved away and sliced it to third man
back to back boundaries off Steyn, psychological edge to Rajasthan, this was nicely punched down the ground wide of mid-off off a full delivery
outside edge but no slip, this was full and swinging away, he drove hard at it and the edge flew past the keeper and down to third man, fifty for Rahane! Well played
in the air but very safe in the end, it was pitched up and he made a bit of room to carve that over the off side, bisected mid-off an cover very well, the field was up
close call for Binny as he made room to pull and miscued it just wide of midwicket, they take two
this was a low full toss and ha made room and ended up pushing it back to bowler off the toe of the bat
Binny makes room to Ishant but a bit too much, ends up chopping it back down the track
good running, he pushes it with soft hands towards cover point and sets off
this was short and wider outside off and he punches it wide of point and Bhuvneshwar is swift in the deep
length ball on middle and leg and turned to the leg side
goes back at the crease and plays with the turn to the offside
he rocks back and pulls and it's in the air but drops short of deep midwicket
goes back at the crease and pulls along the ground
gets forward and across and pushes it wide of cover
he stays back and punches it to the off side
Rahane continues to charge Ishant, gets an inside edge
that was punched nicely on the back foot, beats cover and the sweeper mops up
he stays behind the line and punches it to the off side
ouch! That nearly dislodges the visor altogether! Rahane picks the wrong ball to charge down the track, it was short and as he pulled the ball hit him straight on the grill and the screws come off
this is slightly short and wide and he makes room and carves it down to third man
he comes down the track and gets an inside edge to deep square leg
turned away towards deep square leg and Ishant does well to slide and cut it off

picks the googly late, tucks it to the on side and they set off, the throw to the bowler's end was wide and the Hyderabad fielders ask the umpires if Binny was obstructing the throw intentionally, the umpires have a short discussion but they move on
flatter one and turned to the on side, Mishra himself does the chasing
skids through, stays back and punches it back to the bowler
committed to the sweep early, tossed up on the pads and he gets down and sweeps with conviction
tossed up and he gets forward and drives
another clean pull, this is poor bowling, too short, sits up nicely for the pull, one bounce to deep midwicket
moves away from him and he looks to cut but misses

did that go all the way? This was bowled short and sat up nicely for Binny to biff it over midwicket, the question was whether the ball hit the boundary cushion on the full or on the half volley, Richard Illingworth asks the third umpire and after studying a few replays he calls it a six
he makes room and he chops it towards point
bowls it wide outside off and he flays at it and clears cover
he comes down the track and works a low full toss to midwicket
looked like another googly, inside edge to the pads
this was tickled down the leg side
the sharp googly, Binny was down the track and didn't pick it, inside edge to the leg side
tosses it down the leg side and he sweeps
tosses it down the leg side and he sweeps between the keeper's legs
Mishra tosses it up and he comes forward and drives wide of mid-off
he stays back to a length ball and works it to the on side
this was too wide outside off
he gets forward and across and pushes it to the off side
stays beside the line and he angles it down to third man and Binny runs the first quickly, allows the second
full on middle and leg and he pushes it down to long-on
he opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man
goes back and punches it towards cover
poor ball to end the over though, short and wide outside off and Rahane wasn't missing out, slapped to deep point
tests him out with a bouncer that has Rahane weaving backwards to evade it, Ishant breathing fire
this was quite wide outside off and not called though
he stays back and works it to the on side

Ishant's got Watson and as if he can't believe what he's done, he turns back to Billy Bowden and waits for the crooked finger, this was pitched up on the off stump, just the right length, Watson comes forward and there's a thick outside edge to the keeper, it was very obvious, Ishant waits and waits and Bowden does the needful
gets forward and gets an inside edge to the boot and they set off
defended to point and that ends a superb over of swing from Bhuvi
he punches it just wide of mid-off
now this one swerves back in and beats Rahane! Quality swing bowling here, sliced him in half and the keeper fumbles
Watto's still looking wobbly! This was fuller and on the stumps, forced him to come forward and play and there's a leading edge that beats gully
and again! Quality stuff from Bhuvi! This was a touch fuller and shaping away, Watson was coming forward and he nearly edged it
that was a peach of a delivery! Squared him up completely by one that shaped in and then moved away, bounced too, how did that not take the edge?
he gets an inside edge to the pads and the ball rolls to the off side and they set off quickly
down the track to a shorter delivery and he mistimes it to the leg side, scampers the single
this was drifting down the leg side and he tries to clip it away
clears the infield, this was a length ball, Ranahe stays at the crease and lofts through the line and clears mid-on
he comes down the track and he plays across the line, clips it down to fine leg
another big swing and a miss, this was outside off and kicking up and he nearly edges it
he stays back and punches it to the off side

Dropped by Finch at first slip! This was a lovely delivery that shaped in rather late, Rahane was forward and the outside edge just evaded the keeper and Finch was a bit late to dive to his left at first slip
he stays back and gets an inside edge to the leg side
that was a soft dismissal! This was  a length ball outside off and Samson looked to clear mid-off but it went off the bottom half of the bat and as a result it went rather tamely to mid-off
gets more solid bat behind it this time, he stays back and punches it wide of cover
another edge to third man, but just a single slip
he stays beside the line and pushes it towards backward point
gets across his stumps and pushes it down the track back to the bowler
full and fast and another outside edge, wide of second slip and down to third man
this was full and driven to cover point and they decide against the single, direct hit at the bowler's end and he's home
outside edge and over second slip, that was swinging away, closes the face and it is picked up by third man
Steyn gets a lovely angle across again and he pokes at it and misses, gets him forward
taps this one towards square leg for a couple
beauty from Bhuvneshwar Kumar, jagging away after pitching on off stump, back of a length ball, Rahane is beaten, terrific stuff
this one doesn't move away, slapped towards point, reaches the fielder on the bounce
pitching back of a length and seams away a long way
overpitched and on the pads, clipped through midwicket for four, once again no attempt to hit that hard, more about getting it wide of a diving square leg
pitched up and on middle and leg, the ball swings away, pitches on middle and leg, defended
lovely delivery from Steyn to end the over, he's on song straight away, hitting short of a length and nibbling away past the outside edge
defends this one back down the pitch
swinging away outside off at 145kph, Samson doesn't get bat on it

Steyn needs only balls to strike, he has Nayar lbw, it was a delayed appeal for lbw, that was a back of length ball around off stump, Nayar tries to whip that away, pad first, a bit of doubt over whether that would have hit off, the umpire is convinced though
on the pads, Nayar looks to clip that behind square, no contact, was going to miss leg stump
overpitched ball outside off, 142.4kph, eases that through cover for four, doesn't try to power that one, gets the placement right
